title: Falsify: test the evidence behind the claim

voice.direction: Clear, warm, confident English narration with calm scientific precision. Allow brief pauses at evidence changes. Use a stock or otherwise authorized voice.

readiness.reason: Actual ElevenLabs narration, exact source transcriptions, immutable evidence, local comparison and inspected recorded captures verified. Final render in progress.

finalization_checklist.requirement: Confirm the intended system changes are complete and the final interface is stable. Do not finalize while the system is actively changing.

Verify both selected immutable run files, checksums, completed Omnigent status, protocol verification, record-specific event IDs, metrics, verdicts, and elapsed time immediately before rendering. Recheck all narration if selected records change.
Keep scientific evaluation rules fixed before any final runs. Preserve failed or disagreeing results under their true mode.

Capture the final real application at readable resolution with replay labels and exact selected records. Add exactly one image or video path to each scene. Inspect for credentials, private paths, original PDFs, resume content, or unrelated personal data.
finalization_checklist.evidence: output/demo-video/captures/capture-report.json; actual local UI captures match the immutable selected Omnigent records.

finalization_checklist.requirement: Select an available ElevenLabs stock or otherwise authorized voice, set voice_id and model_id, and generate one narration file per scene after the wording is final. Add each audio path and measured duration.
Verify each original narration recording fits its allocated scene without clipping. Rewrite or regenerate if needed. Render exactly 120 seconds with readable captions and short intentional pauses.

Once the system, evidence, chosen ElevenLabs voice, input audio durations and final captures are verified, set readiness.status to ready so the final renderer can run. Keep is_final false until the resulting full video passes audiovisual review.

Watch and listen to the complete rendered video. Check pronunciation, pacing, captions, numbers, replay labels, attribution, limitations, and the final frame. Set is_final to true only after this output review passes. Publishing or event submission still requires user authorization.

evidence_policy.presentation: Recorded replay of actual Omnigent investigations. Watching the replay performs no fresh inference or experiment.
evidence_policy.hypotheses: AI-generated hypotheses must be labeled as such when displayed.
unsupported_claims: No speed multiplier without a measured baseline

scenes.title: Does the score support the claim?
scenes.narration: A model can score well on the wrong test. Falsify asks: does this activity classifier generalize to people it has never seen? The bottleneck is choosing evidence that actually tests the claim.
scenes.visual_direction: Open on the actual final Falsify interface, with the scientific question and protocol visible. Add the title Falsify | Test the evidence behind the claim. Keep the selected record identified as a recorded replay if results are visible. Do not animate an unexecuted run.

scenes.title: Choose the most useful verification
scenes.narration: The planner compares two tests: a cheap participant overlap audit and a costlier held out evaluation. After the baseline, it chooses the audit because participant separation is necessary to test generalization to new people.
scenes.visual_direction: Open the recorded planner decision, not the original-score event. Show two option overlays: Audit participant IDs, very low CPU cost; Held-out evaluation, retrain the fixed classifier. Highlight the selected audit. Label the hypotheses AI-generated: transferable activity signal versus participant overlap. These are candidate explanations, not findings.

scenes.title: A high score, an invalid evaluation
scenes.narration: The original accuracy is about ninety eight percent. But the audit finds twenty one participants in both training and testing. The reviewer requests a new experiment with participants completely separated.
scenes.visual_direction: Show the original 98.01% accuracy, then open evidence E026 with 21 shared participants highlighted. Move focus to the actual reviewer request for participant_holdout. Keep the run identity fixed and the replay label visible.

scenes.title: The prediction survives a better test
scenes.narration: With classifier settings fixed, the operator runs that stronger test. Accuracy remains about ninety six percent. The reviewer rejects the original evaluation while recognizing the repaired evidence. Invalid evaluation does not disprove the predictive claim.
scenes.visual_direction: Show the corrected result and recorded final verdict together. Display 96.17% accuracy, nine held-out study participants, and zero overlap. Include a readable limitation: different populations and sample counts mean the score change does not isolate a causal effect of overlap. Do not label the original predictive claim false.

scenes.title: A valid control should stay valid
scenes.narration: Now the clean control: zero participant overlap. The reviewer retains its result without a redundant classifier run. Both decisions link to the scores, split records, and evidence identifiers.
scenes.visual_direction: Switch visibly to the valid-control record. Show the retained original result and audit evidence, then the evidence export link. Caption: same official split as the repaired case, not an independent replication. Do not portray the retained result as an additional classifier run.

scenes.title: Measured computation, clear limits
scenes.narration: In a separate deterministic comparison, retaining the valid control avoided one redundant classifier fit. This measures local computation after the original result, not end-to-end agent speedup.
scenes.visual_direction: Show the measured deterministic post-original valid-control comparison, clearly distinct from the recorded Omnigent investigation. Disclose the artificial always-rerun baseline and that a fixed rule can avoid the same fit.

scenes.title: The next experiment
scenes.narration: Next, test an independent participant cohort, then assess reviewers against hidden defects and valid controls. Human review remains essential. Falsify makes a claim testable, and its justification inspectable.
